review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people think that school should give rewards to students with the best academic results, while others believe that students with improvements should be rewarded. In my opinion, school should reward both high-achieving students and those who show improvements.

On the one hand, students who have the best academic results deserve to be rewarded. First, students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, so they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, propelling towards overall academic gains. Second, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. Therefore, students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which can enable them to achieve success in later life.

On the other hand, students who show improvements should be rewarded. Only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, which can cause others to think that their effort is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened, gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, emphasizing improvements encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The constant desire to outdo themselves even benefit themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that both excellent academic results and improvements deserve recognition.
review.overall: Cô thấy em đã triển khai được hai hướng của đề và dùng được một số ý trong dàn ý. Điểm cần ưu tiên là viết câu đủ chủ ngữ và động từ, rồi kiểm tra cấu trúc trước khi dùng câu dài. Bản sửa giữ lập trường thưởng cả hai nhóm và giữ cụm praises and privileges đúng theo dàn ý.
